result.summary: Found several layout and content issues, mainly related to cut-off elements at the screen edge and inconsistent card content in the 'Fastest near you' section.

issues.description: The third restaurant card ('Trattoria Piccol...') in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with its name and delivery fee truncated/hidden.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scroll/carousel so cards are either fully visible or clearly indicate scrollability (e.g., partial card with a fade effect) so no text is abruptly cut off.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated without ellipsis, making it look like a typo or broken text rather than an intentionally shortened name.
issues.suggestion: Add ellipsis (...) or ensure text truncation is handled consistently with proper CSS text-overflow styling.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the pizza promo card at the bottom is barely visible due to low contrast between the icon and the dark overlay background.
issues.suggestion: Increase icon contrast or add a subtle background circle to improve visibility against varying image backgrounds.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is abruptly cut off by the screen/viewport, with no visible restaurant name or delivery info, unlike the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it.
issues.suggestion: Ensure consistent card height and scroll behavior so all cards display their key info (name, rating, delivery time) without being cut off by the viewport.

issues.description: Category filter pills ('Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') show inconsistent spacing near the right edge, with a partially visible additional category cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll indication (fade/gradient) or ensure equal spacing so the cut-off category doesn't look like a layout error.
